ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the diagonals AC and BD of rectangle ABCD intersect at point O. Points E and F are the midpoints of AO and AD, respectively. If EF = 4 and AB = 8, what is the measure of $\angle ACB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given rectangle ABCD,\\
thus OD=OB=OA=$\frac{1}{2}$BD, $\angle$ABC=$90^\circ$,\\
since points E and F are the midpoints of AO and AD respectively,\\
thus EF is the midline of $\triangle$AOD,\\
thus EF=$\frac{1}{2}$OD=4,\\
thus OD=8,\\
thus AB=OB=OA,\\
thus $\triangle$AOB is an equilateral triangle\\
thus $\angle$BAC=$60^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle$ACB=$90^\circ$−$\angle$BAC=$90^\circ$−$60^\circ$=$\boxed{30^\circ}$.
